quotes.author: Denise E. • TripAdvisor
quotes.text: As a local, I love taking family and friends on the Sternwheeler to show them the most beautiful views of the Columbia River Gorge. It is wonderful now that they are booking trips through the winter, have a full bar, and snacks. I probably went five times in 2023.

quotes.author: Catherine P. • TripAdvisor
quotes.text: This was a fabulous adventure for us! Gorgeous weather. Staff/Crew treated us with respect, care, and fabulous food! The captain was so knowledgeable and shared soooo much history about the area. Wow! Very impressive. Thank you so very much!

quotes.author: Jesse F. • Google
quotes.text: This is a really fun and educational cruise around the Columbia River. The boat is old and has lots of history, but if you're in the area I highly recommend checking it out. The kids love it and it's a blast from the past.

quotes.author: Elizabeth M. • Google
quotes.text: Spent an awesome afternoon on the Sternwheeler. Great staff, big blue skies and beautiful views. Highly recommend especially the West loop which takes you under the Bridge of the Gods and to the Bonneville Dam.

quotes.author: Raghav A. • Google
quotes.text: Cruise is from a beautiful town called Cascade Locks. We took the last cruise and it involved stunning views. The boat serves drinks and coffee. Has three levels to see the views from. Friendly staff.

quotes.author: Christine W. • TripAdvisor
quotes.text: Beautiful sightseeing trip on the Columbia River. They also offer brunch and dinner cruises. Family friendly and great views. The captain also gives you some history of the gorge on the trip.
